content: Hi! Need help with your tax forms or planning?
Yes, I started a new job and I’m not sure how to fill out the W-4.

No worries! The W-4 helps your employer determine how much federal income tax to withhold. If you want to avoid a big bill at tax time, it’s safest to withhold a bit more. You can also use the IRS Withholding Estimator tool to help you figure it out.
The new W-4 doesn’t use allowances anymore. Instead, you’ll enter details like dependents and other income. Let me know if you want to go through it step by step!
